senses.gloss:
n. (-मं)
Water.
m. (-मः)
A hole.

m. (-कः)
A hare.
E.
रोम hair, and कर्ण the ear, कन् added.

m. (-पः)
A pore of the skin.
E.
रोम hair, and कूप a well, a pit.

n. (-रं)
A Chowri.
E.
रोम hair of an animal, (especially of the Yac,) and केशर a filament.

n. (-च्छं)
A Chowri, a sort of whisk.
E.
रोम hair, (see the last word,) and गुच्छ a cluster; also with कन् added, रोमगुच्छक.

n. (-म)
The hair of the body.
E.
रु to make, Uṇādi aff. मनिन्, form irr.

n. (-न्थं)
Ruminating, chewing the cud, or also eating, without chewing what has been once swallowed and again brought into the mouth.
E.
रोग disease, and मन्थ to destroy or remove, aff. अच्, deriv. irr.; this habit in animals being indispensable^1 to digestion and health.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
Made of or fastened with the hair of animals, (as horse hair, &c.)
E.
रोम, and बद्ध bound.

f. (-मिः)
The skin.
E.
रोम the hair, and भूमि soil, site.

f. (-ता)
A line of hair extending to the navel.
E.
रोम hair, and लता a creeper.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Hairy, woolly.
E.
रोम hair of the body, and मतुप् aff.

m. (-रः)
Horripilation.
E.
रोम the hair of the body, and विकार change of state.

f. (-या)
Horripilation.
E.
रोम the hair, and विक्रिया change.

m. (-शः)
A body louse.
E.
रोम, and विध्वंश loss.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
Hairy, woolly.
m. (-शः)
1 A ram, a sheep.
2 A hog.
E.
रोमन् hair, and श aff.

m. (-र्षः)
Horripilation.
E.
रोम the hair of the body, and हर्ष pleasure.

n. (-णं)
Horripilation, erection or rigidity of the hair of the body, conceived to be occasioned by and to express exquisite delight.
m. (-णः)
1 SŪTA, the pupil of VYĀSA, and supposed narrator of the events recorded in the Purāṇas.
2 Beleric myrobalan.
E.
रोम the hair, and हर्ष्ण delighting.

m. (-ञ्चः)
Horripilation, rigidity and erection of the hair of the body.
E.
रोम the hair, अञ्च to worship, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Having the hair of the body erect, considered as a proof of exquisite pleasure; enraptured, delighted.
E.
रोमाञ्च horripilation, इतच् aff.

f. (-ली)
A line of hair, extending across the navel.
E.
रोमन् hair, and आली a line.

f. (-ली)
A line of hair across the middle of the belly or navel.
E.
रोम, and आवली a line.

m. (मः)
Horripilation.
E.
रोम hair, उद्गम rising; also रोमोद्ग m. (-द्गः).

m. (-दः)
Horripilation.
E.
रोम hair of the body, and उद्भेद breaking forth, protrusion.
